The '''2014–15 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Kansas State University]] in the [[2014–15 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Their head coach was [[Bruce Weber (basketball)|Bruce Weber]],<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130121060332/http://kstatesports.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/weber_bruce00.html/ViewArticle.dbml|title=Bruce Weber Bio}}</ref> and was his third year at the helm of the Wildcats. The team played its home games in [[Bramlage Coliseum]] in [[Manhattan, KS|Manhattan]], [[Kansas]], its home court since 1988. Kansas State was a member of the [[Big 12 Conference]].

==Preseason==
The [[2013–14 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the previous season 20–13, 10–8 in Big 12 play to finish in fifth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2014 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to Iowa State. They received an at-large bid to the [[2014 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the second round to Kentucky.
